 SELECT a.INT_PRODUCTIDS,b.CHR_NAME,a.CHR_PRODUCTCODE,LEFT(a.CHR_PRODUCTDESC,300), a.CHR_WARRANTY,a.INT_ACTIVE ,   if(a.CHR_PTYPE ='F','Full Product',if(a.CHR_PTYPE='S' ,'Consumables','Swap Product')) , b.CHR_CONFIGURATION    FROM inv_m_produtlist a , inv_m_productgroup b   WHERE a.INT_PRODUCTGROUPID = b.INT_PRODUCTGROUPID  ORDER BY a.CHR_PRODUCTCODE  LIMIT 1000
